name: pi-glm-ocr
description: Pi extension: Local OCR via Ollama GLM-OCR (0.9B) — convert images and PDFs to Markdown / LaTeX with high math formula accuracy. Bridges the multimodal gap for non-vision LLMs like DeepSeek.
